verdict.rationale: Wrike is a work-management platform whose AI features and agents handle tasks, triage, and summaries. It does not author code commits, so signing AI-authored commits with SSH or GPG keys falls outside its product category. Its GitHub two-way sync concerns syncing work items, not producing commits, so it does not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can require AI-authored commits to be cryptographically signed with my SSH or GPG key
